slots.name: radio
slots.body: Pay only for what you use

examples.label: Billing period choice in a checkout
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-group-radio" site="Global" id="checkout-billing-period" name="billing_period" space="small">
How would you like to be billed?
<:radio value="monthly">Monthly — 29 EUR, cancel any time <:radio value="annual" checked={true}>Annually — 290 EUR, two months free <:radio value="metered">Metered — pay for the pages you publish

examples.label: Delivery speed options laid out in a row
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-group-radio" site="Global" id="checkout-delivery-speed" name="delivery_speed" variation="horizontal" space="large" size="small" label_class="text-sm">
  <:radio value="standard" checked={true}>Standard, 3 to 5 days</:radio>
  <:radio value="express">Express, next working day</:radio>
  <:radio value="collect">Collect from the workshop</:radio>
</.component>

examples.label: Survey question with a five-point scale
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-group-radio" site="Global" id="survey-recommend" name="recommend" variation="horizontal" space="medium" size="small" label_class="text-sm">
How likely are you to recommend the editor to a colleague?
<:radio value="1">Not at all <:radio value="2">Unlikely <:radio value="3">Neutral <:radio value="4">Likely <:radio value="5">Very likely
